about_the_game:
It’s time for Refuse & Reuse, a 2D top-down RPG local singleplayer and co-op PC video game based in a world invaded by malicious forms of pollution causing mayhem in the Wild Forests, Ocean depths, Desert Wastelands, and Urban Cities.

Such pollution negatively impacts the Animal Kingdom, putting many endangered species at greater risk. The only ones who can put a stop to this are the leaders of the affected habitats:

                                     

Goran – the Deer Warrior - Destruction of forests and urbanization ruined Goran’s home, and the antler lost in the process only serves as a grave memento of the past. Now a veteran warrior wielding a greatsword and the ability to draw upon the power of his Ancestors, ready to avenge his land.

                                       

Ornelia – the Orca Healer - The once calm Ocean surface suddenly turned dark with chemical liquids that left a mark on both Ornelia’s face and psyche. Once a calm Orca helping others is now a deranged potion brewer and a self-proclaimed “Executioner” wielding an axe and the ability to both heal allies and poison enemies. The Oceans will be clean once again.

                                     

Pya – the Scorpion Ranger - Dwelling on the frontiers of nature, this scorpion gunslinger has felt the effects of pollution herself. Her pincers have been lost in an avalanche of trash, and her once potent poison is a mere drop-worth today. Despite these mere nuisances, her aim is as sharp as ever, and given one bullet, she will surely hit the target dead on. 

                                         

Arnold – the Rafflesia Magician - Taken away from his Jungle at a young age, during plant experimentation Arnold has lost his ability to see. He, however, gained the knowledge of Electricity which he wields with his “magical” staves and uses to control the Spirits of his fallen tribal Rafflesia brethren.

Choose either of the 4 Characters to play as… or play with a friend in the local Co-Op mode! Save endangered animals, interact with the residents of these polluted habitats, combine various materials, craft many trash weapons, and beat the trash out of various pollutant enemies and Bosses!

Features:

  • Singleplayer Adventure and Co-Op Mode - Play alone against hordes of pollutants, or join forces with a friend for even more chaos!

  • 4 Playable characters - Play close and personal with the Deer Warrior Goran or cast projectiles from afar as Rafflesia Magician Arnold!

  • 25 Levels categorized within 5 Environmental Areas - Forest, Ocean, Rural, Urban, and a Dark secret area all contain different level layouts, enemies, NPC’s, and Boss Fights ready for you to encounter and explore!

  • Weapon crafting system - Use the “Triangle of Refusion” to combine 3 different trash materials and create various weaponry for your characters!

  • 30+ Different weapons - Weapons with unique attack patterns and Skills!

  • 25 Boss Fights - Defeat the primary Pollutants of each Area in an epic onslaught! Yes, there is a big Health bar and awesome music accompanying it as well!

  • Original soundtrack - Fantastic music for while you thrash your enemies provided by Yerr!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Malicious forms of pollution invade the world in this 2D top-down RPG co-op Adventure. The heroes of this story? Leaders of their habitats, Goran the Deer, Ornelia the Orca, Pya the Scorpion, Arnold the Rafflesia, and their weaponry crafted from trash materials. Fighting trash WITH trash!
